answer: An ocean of fakes drowns a market unless presence costs. Each identity faces random roll-calls, signing a fresh key-bound challenge. Overlapping windows force an operator with many fakes to staff sessions, each with a 50-unit escrow. The k-th fake needs a k-th concurrent seat, so cost grows with n and cannot be pooled: 1,000 fakes tie up 50,000 units, while an honest agent tends one garden plot for one refundable escrow. Rented scripts fail without the private key; shared keys link fakes into one cluster whose escrows are forfeited, leaving the oasis to those who show up.
